title: Thanksgiving Week to Bring Laredo's Coldest Temperatures Since February
excerpt: Laredo is headed for its coldest weather since Feb. 6, with overnight lows near 41 degrees Wednesday and Thanksgiving morning, according to the National Weather Service.
content:
Laredo is headed for its coldest temperatures since Feb. 6, when the low hit 40 degrees, according to the National Weather Service, as reported by the Laredo Morning Times.

Today, Tuesday, Nov. 24, expect a low of 53 degrees and a high of 58, with a slight chance of rain and winds of 5 to 13 mph gusting to 18 mph. Wednesday, Nov. 25, brings a low of 41 and a high of 61, with the wind chill dropping below 40 degrees and temperatures near 37 degrees between 6 and 8 a.m.

Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, will start with a low of 41 degrees in the early morning hours and warm to a high of 62 by 2 p.m., with no rain expected and light winds. Friday brings a low of 46 and a high of 65; Saturday, a low of 49 and a high of 73; and Sunday, a low of 56 and a high of 77.

Only 12 days in 2026 have reached 41 degrees or lower, and the record low for Nov. 25 and 26 is 27 degrees. November's average high is 75.1 degrees and its average low is 58.3 degrees.

Across the Rio Grande, Nuevo Laredo's civil protection agency is urging residents to take precautions ahead of the cold, according to Telemundo Laredo. Two cold-air systems could push temperatures in Nuevo Laredo down to 6 degrees Celsius, about 43 degrees Fahrenheit, according to La Voz NLD.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 23, 2026 (National Weather Service); La Voz NLD, Nov. 23, 2026; Telemundo Laredo (KXNU), Nov. 23, 2026.
